hooks.command: input=$(cat); tool=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_name'); if echo "$tool" | grep -qiE 'send'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked: sending email on Russ\u2019s behalf is not permitted"}'; exit 2; fi

input=$(cat); cmd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE '(sendmail|\bsmtp\b|nodemailer|\bmutt\b|mail -s)'; then echo '{"decision": "block", "reason": "Blocked: sending email on Russ\u2019s behalf is not permitted"}'; exit 2; fi
